content: शाखा .²1 A branch (as of a tree); आवर्ज्य शाखाः <ls>R. 16. 19</ls>. .²2 An arm. .²3 A party, section, faction. .²4 A part or subdivision of a work. .²5 A school, branch, sect. .²6 A part or division of an animal. .²7 A school or traditional recension of the Veda, the traditional text followed by a school; as in शाकलशाखा, आश्वलायनशाखा, बाष्कलशाखा <ab>&c.</ab> .²8 A branch of any science.
